 FORECAST: Sunny and warm to start the weekend; Rain returns Sunday night 
 By Tawana Andrew Published : Nov. 15, 2026 at 4:13 PM EST | Updated : 52 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WEATHER HEADLINES 
 NEXT 12: Sunny with highs near 70° 
 SHORT TERM: Quiet Saturday with highs in the 60s and low 70s; Rain returns Sunday evening/night 
 LONG TERM: Chilly Thanksgiving week; Watching mid to late-week precipitation chances 
 LATEST FORECAST 
 LOUISVILLE, Ky. (WDRB+WAVE) — Yet another beautiful Fall day is on tap. Sunshine will warm us into the upper 60s and low 70s this afternoon. Clear skies and light winds tonight will allow temperatures to drop quickly after sunset. Lows will settle into the 30s and low 40s by tomorrow morning. 
 Tomorrow looks to be another warm and mainly sunny day. Highs jump into the upper 60s and low 70s tomorrow afternoon. Mostly clear skies remain in our forecast for Saturday night. Lows slide into the 30s and low 40s overnight. 
 Current trends show a mix of sun and clouds, with mostly dry conditions during the day on Sunday. With a dry and sunny forecast and southerly winds, highs look to climb into the upper 60s on Sunday afternoon. 
 Clouds increase Sunday evening before scattered showers move into the region overnight as a cold front crosses the Ohio Valley. The 
 rain moves out early Monday morning as temperatures tumble into the 40s.
